sources.licence_boundary: COD open-data access was used for this bounded record; record-level provenance and reuse remain the user's responsibility.

commands.command: env -u https_proxy -u http_proxy -u all_proxy -u HTTPS_PROXY -u HTTP_PROXY -u ALL_PROXY curl --fail --location --silent --show-error --dump-header output/cod-response.headers --output source/9013102.cif https://www.crystallography.net/cod/9013102.cif

G0.summary: Required case files exist and the CIF SHA-256 binds source and parser output.

G1.summary: The recorded direct HTTPS retrieval returned HTTP 200 and exit code 0.

G2.summary: A database retrieval has no solver or optimizer threshold.

G3.summary: The downloaded CIF, headers, parser output, and structure-analysis artifacts are present.

G5.summary: Retrieval and parsing do not support a physical or scientific conclusion.

supports: The specified COD URL returned the hash-bound CIF through a real Talos HTTPS command.
The captured CIF parsed as an eight-atom Si representation.
does_not_support: COD record identity or crystallographic quality.
Material stability, DFT execution, numerical convergence, or a scientific conclusion.
